releases.notes:
Private test build. Install it the same way as before: put the jar in `.minecraft/mods`, with Fabric Loader 0.18.4 or newer and Fabric API for Minecraft 1.21.11. Remove any older Donut jar first, because Fabric won't start with two copies installed.

**This build expires.** 72 hours after it first runs on your computer, every module switches off for good. The clock runs whether or not the game is open. The menu's footer shows how long is left, and a newer build gets a fresh 3 days. See [the guide](https://github.com/Mr-Pythoneer/donut-client/blob/feature/freecam-storage-qol/docs/GUIDE.md#test-builds-expire-after-3-days).

**New since test build 2:**
- **Kill switch:** the 3-day expiry described above.
- **Anti-cheat results:** every module was tested against Grim, Intave, Spartan, Omni, BS-AntiCheat, DonutAntiCheat and anti-xray. See [anticheat-results.md](https://github.com/Mr-Pythoneer/donut-client/blob/feature/freecam-storage-qol/docs/anticheat-results.md). In short:
  - Visual modules, Freecam and Freelook weren't flagged.
  - Auto Miner, AutoBuilder and Auto Eat get flagged.
  - **Fly gets you kicked or banned within seconds.**
  - Search is fooled by anti-xray.

The modules themselves haven't changed since test build 2.

releases.notes:
Test build 2 of Donut Client for **Minecraft Java 1.21.11** (Fabric). It replaces test build 1.

## Install
1. Install **Fabric Loader** 0.18.4 or newer for Minecraft 1.21.11.
2. Put **Fabric API** 0.141.4+1.21.11 or newer in your `mods` folder.
3. Download **donut-client-3.0.jar** below into the same `mods` folder, replacing any older Donut jar.
4. Start the game, join a world and press **Right Shift**.

Every module starts switched off. The [guide](https://github.com/Mr-Pythoneer/donut-client/blob/feature/freecam-storage-qol/docs/GUIDE.md) explains each tool, with a short video of most of them.

## New in this build
- **Freelook:** hold Left Alt to look around your player without turning it.
- **Player ESP:** players through walls, with nametags showing health, armour, held item and distance. Friends get their own colour.
- **Search:** highlight any blocks you choose, through walls.
- **HUD widgets:** FPS, ping, CPS, compass, clock, key strokes, armour and potion panels.
- **NewChunks:** a hint for chunks being generated for the first time.
- **Stash Finder:** logs chunks full of storage, with waypoints and CSV/JSON export.
- **Auto Reconnect:** a countdown rejoin after a disconnect.
- **Auto Eat:** eats hotbar food when you're hungry, then switches back.

Everything from test build 1 is still included: the Freecam upgrades, Storage ESP, Coordinates, Waypoints, Zoom, Durability Alert, the BlockESP seed predictor, Auto Miner, and the restyled menu and panels.

## Notes
- Only you install it; servers don't need it. It doesn't hide itself. Automation like Auto Miner and Auto Eat is against the rules on many servers.
- This is a test build from branch `feature/freecam-storage-qol`.

releases.notes:
Test build of Donut Client for **Minecraft Java 1.21.11** (Fabric).

## Install
1. Install **Fabric Loader** 0.18.4 or newer for Minecraft 1.21.11.
2. Put **Fabric API** 0.141.4+1.21.11 or newer in your `mods` folder.
3. Download **donut-client-3.0.jar** below and put it in the same `mods` folder (replace any older Donut jar).
4. Start the game, join a world and press **Right Shift** to open the menu.

Every module starts switched off. See the [guide](https://github.com/Mr-Pythoneer/donut-client/blob/feature/freecam-storage-qol/docs/GUIDE.md) for what each tool does, with a short video of each.

## What's in this build
- Freecam upgrades: scroll for speed, smoothing, resume position, follow a player, look at a block.
- Storage ESP, Coordinates, Waypoints, Zoom (hold Z) and Durability Alert.
- BlockESP seed predictor for every overworld ore, with a confidence rating and a seed-match check.
- Auto Miner (Blatant):
  - mines visible ores and picks up the drops;
  - uses Silk Touch, Fortune and Efficiency pickaxes;
  - can tunnel to buried ores.
- Restyled menu and smaller, consistent in-game panels (**HUD → Panel size**).
- Search covers setting names, and settings profiles can be exported and imported.

## Notes
- Only you install it; servers don't need it. It doesn't hide itself, so servers can see you use Fabric. Automation like Auto Miner is against the rules on many servers.
- This is a test build from branch `feature/freecam-storage-qol`, not an official release.
